attributes.board_name: Kansas State Board of Healing Arts

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities related to PT practice (contact hour = 60 minutes): lectures, in-service training on PT skills, college courses (10 h per semester credit), administrative training, self-instruction (literature max 2 h; correspondence/online courses), specialty certification exam (40 h), residency/fellowship of at least 1,000 h (40 h), publications (8-20 h), elected delegate (10 h), student supervision (1 h per 40 h, max 3), presenting CE (3 h per hour). Repeated activities in the same period earn no credit.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed within one year of an odd-year renewal date: no CE for that first renewal; licensed or reinstated more than one but less than two years before: half the hours.
rules.audit_note: Evidence of CE is submitted with the renewal application in odd-numbered years (not in even years). Extension of up to 6 months possible for compelling reasons on request with a completion plan.

topics.who: Kansas physical therapy jurisprudence assessment module (developed by the Board and FSBPT, administered by FSBPT), required for licensed PTs each CE cycle; 1 contact hour within the 40

rules.notes: Licenses renew annually; CE evidence for the preceding two years is due with the renewal in each odd-numbered year. Applies also to compact privilege holders.
rules.rule_quote: …evidence of satisfactory completion within the preceding two-year period of at least 40 contact hours of continuing education for a licensed physical therapist or a physical therapist holding a compact privilege and at least 20 contact hours of continuing education for a certified physical therapist assistant or a physical therapist assistant holding a compact privilege.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same activities as PT (contact hour = 60 minutes).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Certified within one year of an odd-year renewal date: no CE for that first renewal; certified more than one but less than two years before: half the hours.
rules.audit_note: Evidence of CE is submitted with the renewal application in odd-numbered years.
rules.notes: Certified physical therapist assistants. The jurisprudence module requirement in the rule names licensed physical therapists only.
